title: SMRT RenSeq protocol
protocol: Shear 2-4 μg of gDNA using Red miniTUBE on Covaris S2 with specified settings (Intensity – 1, Duty Cycle – 20%, Cycles per Burst – 1000, Treatment time – 600 s, Temperature – 20°C, Water level – 15, Sample volume – 200 μl).
Check DNA shearing on 0.8% agarose gel with a suitable DNA marker.
Add 76 μl (0.4X) resuspended AMPure XP beads to the sheared DNA in a sterile Eppendorf tube and mix well by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place the tube on a magnetic stand to separate beads from supernatant; transfer clear supernatant to a new tube without disturbing the beads.
Add 200 μl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to the tube while it is still on the magnetic stand; incubate for 30 seconds at room temperature and discard the supernatant carefully.
Repeat wash step twice more, performing three washes in total.
Briefly spin the tube for 1-2 seconds.
Completely remove residual ethanol and air dry beads for up to 10 minutes while on magnetic stand with lid open.
Elute DNA from beads using 65 μl nuclease-free water.
Mix elution solution well by pipetting up and down.
Place tube on magnetic stand until supernatant is clear.
Transfer the supernatant to a sterile, nuclease-free Eppendorf tube.
Check size-selected fraction on 0.8% agarose gel (it should contain fragments >2 kb).
Mix DTT in End Repair Reaction buffer thoroughly.
Mix components for end repair reaction: End Prep Enzyme Mix – 3.0 μl, End Repair Reaction Buffer (10X) – 6.5 μl, Fragmented DNA – 55.5 μl.
Mix by pipetting and spin to collect all liquid from the tube sides.
Incubate at 20°C for 30 minutes.
Add 3 μl of USER enzyme to the ligation mixture.
Mix well and incubate at 37°C for 20 minutes.
Use ~0.5X AMPure beads as there is no need to perform a more stringent size selection step here.
Add 43 μl resuspended by vortexing AMPure XP beads to the ligation reaction.
Mix well by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin briefly (1-2 s) and place the tube on a magnetic stand to separate beads from supernatant.
After the solution is clear (about 5 minutes), carefully transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Add 200 μl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to the tube while on the magnetic stand.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, and then carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat wash step twice, to three washes in total.
Briefly spin the tube (1-2 s) and put it back on the magnetic stand.
Completely remove residual ethanol and air dry beads for up to 10 minutes while the tube is on the magnetic stand with lid open.
Elute DNA target from beads with 25 μl nuclease-free water.
Mix well by pipetting up and down and put the tube on a magnetic stand until solution clears.
Transfer supernatant to a sterile, nuclease-free Eppendorf tube.
Mix adaptor ligated DNA fragments, 2X KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix, index primer, universal PCR primer, and water in a sterile, nuclease-free PCR tube to a total volume of 50 μl for PCR amplification.
Denature at 98°C for 4 minutes.
Anneal at 65°C for 30 seconds and extend at 72°C for 4 minutes for each cycle (repeat 8-15 cycles).
Perform final extension at 72°C for 10 minutes.
Transfer PCR reaction (45 μl) to a sterile, nuclease-free Eppendorf tube.
Add 18 μl of resuspended AMPure XP beads and mix well by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin briefly (1-2 s) and place the tube on a magnetic stand to separate beads from supernatant.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube carefully without disturbing the beads containing target DNA fragments.
Add 200 μl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to the tube while it is on the magnetic stand.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat wash step twice, performing three washes in total.
Briefly spin the tube (1-2 s) and put it back on the magnetic stand.
Completely remove residual ethanol and air dry beads for up to 10 minutes with the tube lid open while on the magnetic stand.
Elute DNA target from the beads using 20 μl nuclease-free water.
Mix well by pipetting up and down and place the tube on a magnetic stand until the solution is clear.
Transfer the supernatant to a sterile, nuclease-free Eppendorf tube.
Check size-selected fraction on a 0.8% agarose gel.
Hybridize PCR amplified genomic libraries with complementary RNA baits for target DNA enrichment according to MYbaits protocol and kit instructions.
Perform hybridization in half of the reaction volume based on high capture efficiency observed over time.
Equilibrate HYB #4 tube at room temperature to fully dissolve SDS that may have precipitated during storage at 4°C.
In a sterile, nuclease-free PCR tube, mix SeqCAP with 2.5 μl.
Add Block #3 – 0.3 μl to the mixture.
Mix Long Illumina library from step 2.2.5 (250-500 ng) in 3.5 μl with previous components.
Transfer the tube containing the Library Master Mix to the thermocycler and incubate at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Hold the mixture at 65°C with the ‘heated lid’ option enabled while continuing the experiment.
Proceed to Hybridization Master Mix preparation.
In a sterile, nuclease-free PCR tube, mix Hyb #1 – 4.5 µl.
Add Hyb #2 – 0.25 µl to the mixture.
Mix Hyb #3 – 1.75 µl with the solution.
Combine Hyb #4 – 0.25 µl into the mixture.
Add RNase Block – 0.5µl to the solution.
Include Baits – 2.5 µl in the mix.
Mix the components by vortexing, followed by a quick spin to collect all liquid from the sides of the tube.
Transfer the tube containing the Hybridization Master Mix to the thermocycler and incubate at 65°C for 5 minutes.
While keeping the tube at 65°C, transfer 9 μl of Hybridization Master Mix to the Library Master Mix and mix by pipetting.
Hybridize solution at 65°C for 16-24 hours.
Preheat Wash Buffer 2 to 65°C for at least 1 hour before starting.
In a 50 ml tube, combine 400 μl HYB #4, 39.6 ml nuclease-free water and 10 ml Wash Buffer 2.
Heat the Wash Buffer 2.2 to 65°C for at least 45 minutes before use.
Transfer 20 μl of MyOne Streptavidin C1 magnetic beads to a sterile, nuclease-free Eppendorf tube.
Place the tube on a magnetic stand to separate beads from supernatant.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μl Binding Buffer to wash the beads.
Vortex the tube for 5-10 seconds, place on the magnetic stand for 2 minutes, then carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat wash step twice for a total of three washes.
Resuspend the beads in 35 μl Binding Buffer and incubate at 65°C for 2 minutes.
Transfer the hybridization solution to the Binding Buffer/Beads.
Incubate for 45 minutes at 65°C, mixing every 5-10 minutes.
Pellet the beads on the magnetic stand and discard the supernatant.
Add 500 μl of Wash Buffer 2.2 from 65°C to the beads.
Mix by pipetting and incubate for 10 minutes at 65°C, flicking occasionally to resuspend the beads.
Pellet the beads on the magnetic stand and discard the supernatant.
Repeat washing step twice more for a total of three washes.
Remove any remaining buffer after the third wash with a quick spin and re-pelleting.
Resuspend the beads in 20 μl molecular biology grade water.
Prepare a 50 μl PCR reaction on ice in a nuclease-free PCR tube.
Add captured library – 1 μl, 2X KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix – 25 μl, P5 primer (10 μM) – 1.5 μl, P7 primer (10 μM) – 1.5 μl, and water – 22.5 μl.
Mix the PCR reaction by pipetting thoroughly before proceeding.
Perform initial denaturation at 98°C for 4 minutes.
Denature the sample at 98°C for 30 seconds during each cycle of PCR.
Anneal the sample at 65°C for 30 seconds during each cycle of PCR.
Extend the sample at 72°C for 4 minutes during each cycle of PCR.
Perform a final extension at 72°C for 10 minutes after all cycles are completed.
Check 5 μl of PCR product on a 0.8% agarose gel.
Perform enrichment efficiency check using qPCR.
Design primers in genes used for enrichment for the qPCR analysis.
